title: ABM/SRE
description:
Company Name : **Purvaja Fincap Private Ltd**

Timing : 9:30 to 5:30

Head Office : Thripunithura

Available Position : Assistant Branch Manager and Senior Executive

Branch : Perumbavoor

**ASSISTANT BRANCH MANAGER**

Duties and Responsibilities:

* Business Development: Support the Branch Manager in achieving monthly business targets for loans, sales, and other financial products.
* Team Management: Supervise and guide branch employees to improve productivity and overall performance.
* Customer Relationship Management: Maintain good relationships with existing customers and develop new customer relationships.
* Loan Processing: Monitor loan applications, documentation, verification, and disbursement procedures as per company policy.
* Sales and Marketing: Identify new business opportunities and promote the company's financial products.
* Collection Monitoring: Monitor repayment performance, overdue accounts, and collection activities.
* Branch Operations: Ensure the smooth functioning of daily branch activities and compliance with company procedures.
* Staff Performance: Review employee performance, attendance, daily work reports, and target achievements.
* Reporting: Submit daily, weekly, and monthly business reports to the Branch Manager or higher management.
* Compliance: Ensure proper documentation, customer verification, and adherence to applicable company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Problem Resolution: Assist in resolving customer complaints and operational issues.
* Leadership Support: Take responsibility for branch activities in the Branch Manager's absence, as authorized.

**SENIOR RELATIONSHIP EXECUTIVE**

Duties and Responsibilities:

* Customer Acquisition: Identify and approach potential customers to generate new business for the branch.
* Sales and Marketing: Promote the company's loan products and other financial services to eligible customers.
* Lead Generation: Generate business leads through field visits, referrals, customer references, and local marketing activities.
* Customer Relationship: Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
* Loan Documentation: Collect and verify customer documents and ensure that loan applications are complete and accurate.
* Field Visits: Conduct customer visits for business development, verification, follow-ups, and relationship management.
* Repayment Follow-up: Follow up with customers regarding due payments and support collection activities as assigned.
* Business Target Achievement: Achieve assigned monthly sales, customer acquisition, and other performance targets.
* Market Research: Identify local business opportunities, customer requirements, and competitor activities.
* Daily Work Reporting: Submit daily work reports (DWR), customer visit details, lead status, and sales updates to the reporting manager.
* Customer Service: Respond to customer queries and coordinate with relevant departments to resolve issues.
* Policy Compliance: Follow company procedures, maintain confidentiality of customer information, and ensure ethical sales practices.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**DevOps Engineer (1+ Years Experience)Company: Linways Technologies Pvt.Ltd**  
**Location: KochiAbout US**

**We are on a mission to help people learn smarter, live better, and change the world. At Linways, we are building a highly available, secure, and scalable learning platform that enables universities to create smarter learners for tomorrow’s challenges. Today, our system supports 1.5 million learners and is growing rapidly, backed by a modern, cloud-native architecture designed to handle increasing scale, complexity, and security demands. As part of our platform team, you will help design and build the core capabilities that power personalized, data-driven education at scale.**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with 1+ year of experience to join our Infrastructure team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Python-based automation, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.**

**We’re seeking a self-driven engineer who can take ownership of DevOps practices, improve infrastructure reliability and scalability, and drive automation across the development, deployment, and operational lifecycle.**

**Responsibilities**

* **Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available production systems.**
* **Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code workflows.**
* **Proactively monitor system health and performance, and troubleshoot complex issues across the stack.**
* **Implement and improve observability systems including logging, tracing, and alerting.**
* **Ensure best practices in version control, branching strategies, and release management.**
* **Collaborate with developers to streamline delivery, support incident response, and improve system resilience.**
* **Take ownership of infrastructure cost optimization, resource tagging, and usage reporting.**
* **Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices by integrating security into the CI/CD and infrastructure layers.**

**Requirements**

* **1+ years of hands-on experience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering role.**
* **Good understanding of Linux systems and networking fundamentals and troubleshooting.**
* **Strong scripting skills in Python and Bash; Python is mandatory.**
* **Proficient with Docker and container orchestration using Kubernetes.**
* **Solid experience managing infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP.**
* **Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), preferably Terraform.**
* **Experience with configuration management tools, preferably Ansible.**
* **Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices, including GitHub Actions or Jenkins.**
* **Deep understanding of Git workflows, GitOps practices, and release management.**
* **Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, or Loki.**
* **Knowledge of secret management and secure deployment practices (e.g., Vault, SOPS).**
* **Ability to document infrastructure, processes, and operational runbooks effectively.**

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
